selection_credit: The twenty Vesper contracts are selected for literal preservation and earn zero Lyren novelty or automatic completion credit.

selected_inherited.description: Preserve owner-neutral route expectations and exact current/next-owner refusal behavior.
Preserve duplicate-key JSON refusal and the unique-key passing witness.
Preserve NFC and case-fold path-collision tribunals without claiming exhaustive cross-platform safety.
Preserve bidi and disallowed-control filename refusal.
Preserve Git symlink, gitlink, and unsupported entry-kind refusal.
Preserve deterministic Merkle-bound exact-delta manifests.
Preserve deterministic canonical receipt digests as bounded compatibility evidence.
Preserve repository-relative committed baton path, blob, SHA-256, and word-range integrity.
Preserve sparse-before-materialization and the hard 2000-file rotation threshold.
Preserve explicit literal changed-test dependency closure.
Preserve deterministic normalized test-output digests and one-pass attribution.
Preserve bounded Markdown target auditing without accessibility-complete claims.
Preserve current roster and authorization state transitions without rewriting delivery history.
Preserve one owner-neutral exact-final canonical aggregate and no replay after success.
Preserve GMUT provenance-functional representation without empirical promotion.
Preserve THOS synthetic digital-preservation handover boundaries.
Preserve Freed ID content-integrity structural ordering without real keys or trust claims.
Preserve structurally accessible report evidence while reserving manual and affected-user evaluation.
Preserve the independent real corpus and independent audit open gap.
Preserve CBR remedy, legal, cultural, affected-party, and Maori-authority exact gates.

new_proposals.title: Windows reserved-device path refusal
new_proposals.hypothesis: A component-level path policy can reject case-insensitive DOS device names, including names with ordinary suffixes, before an archive member or output path is materialized.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A reserved name such as CON, AUX, NUL, COM1, or LPT9 passes, or an ordinary visually similar component is rejected.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Every preregistered reserved component fails closed and ordinary components pass without filesystem mutation.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the path, retain the failed fixture, and require an additive safe rename.

new_proposals.title: Trailing-dot and trailing-space path refusal
new_proposals.hypothesis: Rejecting components that normalize ambiguously after trailing dot or space removal can prevent alias collisions on common Windows filesystems.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: An ambiguous component passes or a component with an internal ordinary dot or space is rejected.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Trailing-dot and trailing-space fixtures fail while bounded ordinary components pass.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the ambiguous member and stop extraction or publication.

new_proposals.title: Unicode confusable review queue
new_proposals.hypothesis: A small explicit confusable skeleton map can flag preregistered high-risk Latin, Greek, and Cyrillic lookalikes for human review without pretending to implement the complete Unicode confusables standard.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A preregistered lookalike is missed, distinct safe fixtures are collapsed, or the bounded map is called exhaustive.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: The preregistered confusables share the intended skeleton, safe controls remain distinct, and every match is review-only.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Remove any overbroad mapping, retain the failing fixture, and issue no exhaustive-security credit.

new_proposals.title: Archive-member normalization and traversal parity
new_proposals.hypothesis: Normalizing separators and dot segments before policy evaluation can make forward-slash and backslash traversal attempts receive the same fail-closed result.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: One separator form escapes, an absolute or drive-qualified member passes, or a safe nested member is flattened incorrectly.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Absolute, drive-qualified, empty, and parent-traversal members fail; safe relative members normalize deterministically.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Refuse extraction and retain the exact offending member without touching the filesystem.

new_proposals.title: Canonical CBOR synthetic-vector board
new_proposals.hypothesis: A source-linked board can represent deterministic CBOR ordering, shortest-form, and duplicate-key obligations without claiming a complete encoder, decoder, or conformance suite.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: The board claims wire conformance, accepts duplicate semantic keys, or treats prose representation as executed interoperability.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: The board names the bounded obligations and retains all encoder, decoder, interoperability, and cryptographic work outside completion.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reclassify any overclaimed row and retain the absent executable vector as a gap.

new_proposals.title: DSSE envelope structural tribunal
new_proposals.hypothesis: A bounded structural validator can require one payload type, decodable base64 payload, and a nonempty signature array shape without verifying any real signature.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Malformed base64, absent payload type, duplicate signer identifiers, or empty signatures receive a structural pass.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Valid synthetic structure passes and each preregistered malformed structure fails, while signature_verified remains false.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Refuse the envelope and retain the fixture; never substitute structural shape for cryptographic verification.

new_proposals.title: in-toto statement-shape tribunal
new_proposals.hypothesis: A bounded parser can require the in-toto statement type, nonempty subject names with digest mappings, and a predicate type without verifying provenance truth.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A missing subject digest, wrong statement type, or empty predicate type passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: The bounded shape contract passes and fails exactly as preregistered, with provenance_verified false.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the malformed statement and issue zero provenance or supply-chain credit.

new_proposals.title: Declared clock-source contract
new_proposals.hypothesis: Receipts that name whether time came from caller input, monotonic measurement, or wall-clock observation can prevent silent mixing of incomparable clock semantics.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: An unknown clock source passes, monotonic time is serialized as civil time, or a deterministic receipt silently reads the wall clock.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only declared sources pass and deterministic payload construction accepts caller-supplied timestamps without hidden clock reads.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the receipt and require explicit caller input or a separately labeled observation.

new_proposals.title: Locale-invariant ordering contract
new_proposals.hypothesis: Sorting identifiers by explicit Unicode code-point order rather than ambient locale can make bounded manifests stable across host locale settings.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Ambient locale changes ordering, equivalent input permutations produce different output, or the result is called culturally correct collation.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: All input permutations return the same explicit code-point order and no cultural-collation claim is made.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the unstable witness and bind the comparer explicitly before publication.

new_proposals.title: Timestamp-independent content commitment
new_proposals.hypothesis: Excluding observation timestamps from a declared content commitment can make semantic receipts reproducible while retaining time in a separate unhashed observation envelope.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Changing only observation time changes the content digest, or changing semantic content leaves it unchanged.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Time-only changes preserve the content digest and semantic changes alter it.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Keep ordinary full-file SHA-256 authoritative and withdraw the semantic commitment if field separation fails.

new_proposals.title: Executable-bit allowlist policy
new_proposals.hypothesis: A literal executable-path allowlist can distinguish intentional mode 100755 files from accidental executable-bit drift within an owner delta.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: An undeclared executable passes, a declared ordinary file is forced executable, or the policy scans unchanged history.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only exact allowlisted 100755 paths pass and all other exact-delta files must be 100644.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the delta, retain the mode drift, and correct only the attributable path additively.

new_proposals.title: Non-UTF8 text-blob refusal
new_proposals.hypothesis: A strict UTF-8 decoder can refuse malformed exact-delta text blobs before JSON, Markdown, privacy, or source review interprets replacement characters as real content.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Malformed bytes silently decode with replacement characters or valid Unicode text is rejected.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: All valid fixtures round-trip exactly and every malformed fixture fails with its label retained.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the blob and preserve raw Git bytes without lossy rewrite.

new_proposals.title: External receipt signature and trust-anchor gate
new_proposals.hypothesis: A future externally governed signature could bind the exact canonical receipt to an approved key and trust policy.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: No exact key owner, algorithm policy, trust anchor, revocation policy, timestamp authority, or verification ceremony is authorized.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Remain exact_gate with zero key generation, signing, trust assertion, or external account mutation.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Stop before key access or signing and retain the absent authority without a synthetic substitute.

new_proposals.title: Affected-user accessibility evaluation plan
new_proposals.hypothesis: A reservation plan can identify keyboard, screen-reader, cognitive, responsive, print, language, and affected-user evaluations without pretending software performed them.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Structural HTML checks are promoted to complete accessibility, affected-user approval, Maori-language evaluation, or cultural authority.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: The plan is explicit and every manual, language, cultural, and affected-user evaluation remains unexecuted.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Remove any completion wording and retain the absent evaluations visibly.

new_proposals.title: Independent preregistered reproduction team
new_proposals.hypothesis: A separately governed team could preregister the exact delta, environment, fixtures, and falsifiers before independent reproduction.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: No separate team, independent infrastructure, preregistration, or governance agreement is available in this phase.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Remain open_gap; same-owner execution under shared infrastructure receives no independent-reproduction credit.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Do not simulate independence and retain the missing external witness.

new_proposals.title: Digest-algorithm registry refusal
new_proposals.hypothesis: A closed registry that currently permits only sha256 can reject unknown, empty, option-like, or ambiguous digest algorithm labels before comparison.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: An unknown algorithm silently falls back, aliases compare inconsistently, or an option-like label reaches a command surface.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only the exact normalized sha256 label passes; every other label fails without external execution.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the unrecognized label and require an additive reviewed registry extension.

new_proposals.title: Duplicate archive-member refusal
new_proposals.hypothesis: Refusing duplicate normalized archive member names can prevent last-entry-wins ambiguity and hidden overwrite semantics.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Two separator or dot-segment variants normalize to one member yet pass, or distinct members are merged.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Every normalized duplicate fails with both original labels retained and distinct names pass.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Refuse the archive and retain the full duplicate set without extraction.

new_proposals.title: Length-prefixed Merkle-leaf framing
new_proposals.hypothesis: Explicit byte-length prefixes for path, mode, blob id, size, and SHA-256 fields can prevent concatenation ambiguity in owner-delta Merkle leaves.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Two distinct field tuples produce identical framed bytes or field reordering is ignored.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Distinct preregistered tuples have distinct frames and identical tuples reproduce exactly.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Keep per-file hashes authoritative and withdraw the framed commitment if ambiguity is found.

new_proposals.title: GMUT dimension and sign-convention fold board
new_proposals.hypothesis: A typed symbolic board can represent how dimensions, signature, sign convention, domain, approximation, provenance, and falsifier fields accompany a candidate GMUT term.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: The board is dimensionally incoherent or is presented as a force, prediction, constraint, empirical confirmation, or Theory-of-Everything proof.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: The board remains internally typed and explicitly refuses empirical promotion.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain any mismatch and reclassify the board as unexecuted representation.

new_proposals.title: THOS and Freed ID contradiction-preserving handover matrix
new_proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic matrix can represent package identity, attestation shape, recovery state, contradiction, escalation, remedy reservation, and handover readback without making a real operational or identity decision.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A synthetic state is promoted to real safety, identity, trust, remedy, legal, cultural, privacy, or Maori-authority evidence.
primary_source_needs: current THOS, Freed ID, and CBR boundaries
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: All contradictions remain visible and no real decision, person, institution, credential, or authority is represented as validated.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Remove any real-world claim and retain only the bounded synthetic representation.

boundary: This immutable x1 freeze is planning evidence only. It does not implement x2, close any gate, validate a final commit, deliver a baton, or authorize Stage 20.
